events.name: 🚀 Member Onboarding: Get Connected
events.description: Welcome to the community! 👋 Jump into this quick daily huddle to introduce yourself, meet fellow members, and find your footing in the server. Whether you want to pitch a concept, ask a quick question, or just listen in and see what we’re building here, this is your starting point. No high-pressure pitches, just a casual space to sync up and get oriented. Runs Monday through Friday. See you in the voice channel!

events.name: Friday Automation - Showcase your project
events.description: Talk to @Mel DeWeese or @ximonomix to reserve a spot.

events.name: Community Leader Session
events.description: This session is for current community leaders and anyone interested in becoming one. We’ll discuss how we can better support our members, strengthen the community, and help create a welcoming and engaging environment for everyone.

events.name: The Resonant Co-Op Engine
events.description: Got a project that needs hands, or skills looking for a collaborative spark? This is where they meet. The Co-Op Engine is our weekly 45-minute sync for turning ideas into working team experiments. Come to share a concept, offer your skills, or just listen in and see how we collaborate. Everyone is welcome, no experience required. How the 45 minutes run: 00:00 - 00:05 | Grounding: A quick welcome. 00:05 - 00:30 | The Match Floor: Rapid 90-second outlines. Share a project, a skill, or a collabora…

events.name: ResonantDAO Exploration & Community Sync
events.description: In this 90-minute call, we explore our DAO, from token economics and social dynamics to growth and governance. We share updates on what we’re building, including ResonantOS, and discuss upcoming community calls and initiatives. Duration: 1 hour and 30 minutes.

events.name: ResonantOS — Tech Team Sync
events.description: This is the weekly sync for the Tech Team working on ResonantOS. The meeting is for sharing updates, coordinating work, and resolving blockers. It's a technical call meant to speed up development and align the team on priorities and milestones. Duration: 45 minutes, weekly.

events.name: Resonant Academy
events.description: We learn from one another. We learn through doing.

events.name: AI Stack
events.description: Hardware to harness, helping each member design the right personal AI stack. Join us to learn and get personal advice.

events.name: Creative Lab — ResonantDAO
events.description: Making things alone is hard. Creative Lab is where the creatives and artists of ResonantDAO come together to do the work, not talk about it, but actually make. Bring your ideas, your half-finished projects, your stuck pieces. Share what you're exploring, get real feedback, support others, and build things together. No agendas, no deliverables, just creative time among people who get it. This isn't about tech or AI. It's about craft, expression, and the human side of making. We learn together, p…

events.name: ResonantOS Coding Academy
events.description: AI workflows, development practices, and live Q&A.

events.name: Discovery Time run by Coughfee
events.description: An hour for people who are building with AI and are still early on. No technical bar to clear. How it runs: Round the room: 1–2 min each on your win or your best failure of the week. Passing is fine. Showcase: one 10–20 min walkthrough of a real project. Usually a beginner demo build in Claude using Throughliner; sometimes someone else's Throughliner setup in whatever environment they work in. Bring a half-finished thing, bring something that broke, or bring nothing and just listen.
